# Britannica Curiosity Compass

> > Britannica's interactive personality assessment tool that identifies your curiosity type and connects you with famous figures who share your learning style.

The Curiosity Compass is Britannica's science-backed quiz platform that helps users discover their unique curiosity personality—from Explorer to Intuitive Discoverer—while exploring the neuroscience of curiosity and learning. Results connect users to historical figures like Marie Curie, Malala Yousafzai, and Amelia Earhart who exemplify different curiosity types.
